Talia (CS): Quick capture from today's Reef Health onboarding — consolidated asks and churn signals. Highlights: 1) request for per-route spend caps (they run nightly bulk embeddings for search), 2) need clearer retry/error traces surfaced in Console for their infra team, 3) observed embeddings recall degradation on long OCR'd manuals (>8k chars), 4) asked for a two-page self-serve best-practices playbook. They signaled possible renewal review in 5 weeks and want visible progress.

Ethan - PM: thanks, this looks actionable. Can we get a reproducible sample for the embedding drop and a count of how many accounts reported this? Route-spend caps sound like highest commercial impact.

Talia (CS): uploaded anonymized sample to CS-9122 and pasted the minimal payload they provided: ```{\"doc_id\":\"reef-012\",\"chars\":9300,\"notes\":\"OCR'd lab manuals + scanned tables\"}``` They reported similarity drop after ~7.5k tokens.

Ravi (Support): I pulled related tickets: INC-4022, INC-4059, INC-4071. That's 3 accounts in the last month flagged with "low-recall" on long docs. I'll attach anonymized samples to CS-9122 and add severity tags.

Ivy (Eng): initial hypothesis = chunking strategy + noisy OCR. If the sample reproduces, I'll run a 3-day spike to experiment with chunk size and overlap. Interim recommendations might be 1k-2k token chunks with 15-25% overlap and header/footer stripping.

Lina (Docs): I can draft a 2-page playbook focused on long-doc embeddings: chunking patterns, overlap examples, OCR cleanup tips, and an SDK snippet. Low effort.

Talia (CS): csbot logged: "customer_signal: Reef - feature_ask/CS-9122" link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-9122

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-9122 (Reef). Priority: at-risk candidate.

Ethan - PM: proposed prioritization: 1) per-route spend caps (pilot; revenue protection), 2) retry/error visibility in Console (observability + SRE), 3) embeddings repro + guidance (engineering spike), 4) publish 2-page playbook (docs). Thoughts?

Ravi (Support): agree. I'll tag Reef as revenue-risk and surface the repeat-offender counts in the groom. Also will add a short severity field on tickets: "revenue-risk" vs "ux-annoyance" as requested.

Ivy (Eng): I'll own the reproduce spike (owner). If chunking is root cause, I estimate 3 days for experiments + a short writeup. If it's model/encoder behavior, timeline grows. Posting notes in CS-9122 when I start.

Lina (Docs): I'll have a draft playbook by EOD Thu and include example config snippets for both SDK and Console.

Talia (CS): drafting customer note: "Hi Morgan — thanks for the call. We're opening a short pilot to add per-route spend caps and running a quick engineering spike to investigate embeddings recall. We'll share a 2-page tuning playbook this week and follow up with timelines after the spike. — Talia"

Ethan - PM: action items: Ivy -> reproduce (owner). Lina -> docs playbook. Ravi -> attach tickets + add severity tags. Talia -> customer comms and pilot coordination. I'll schedule a 20-min groom tomorrow to scope the route-cap UI and billing instrumentation.

Talia (CS): quick ask — if anyone thinks the playbook should be deprioritized in favor of immediate engineering work, flag now.

Ivy (Eng): keep both parallel; playbook is low-ceremony and helps customers immediately. Also will test the interim overlap/chunk guidance asap. :+1:

Ravi (Support): added CS-9122 labels [revenue-risk, onboarding-blocker]. Attaching the three samples now.

csbot: Label update: CS-9122 tagged [revenue-risk, candidate].

Ethan - PM: thanks all. Let's keep momentum so we can report back before Reef's renewal discussion.

Talia (CS): scheduling 15-min groom for tomorrow 10am PT and linking CS-9122. Closing thread for now, will post updates in the ticket.

Lina (Docs): will post draft to CS-9122 when ready.

Ivy (Eng): will update here if I hit any blockers while reproducing.
